mapper.select: select csic.id, csic.update_time, csic.sku_id, csic.sku_no, csic.country, csic.shop_id, csic.platform, csic.remark, csic.cfg_rule_calc_id, crc.name, crc.code from calc_sales_info_dim csic inner join cfg_rule_calc crc on csic.cfg_rule_calc_id = crc.id and crc.is_deleted = false where csic.id = #{id}

select csic.id, csic.sku_id, csic.sku_no, csic.country, csic.shop_id, csic.platform, csic.sales_qty_json, csic.avg_sales_qty_json, csic.cfg_rule_calc_id, crc.start_calc_date, crc.end_calc_date from calc_sales_info_dim csic inner join cfg_rule_calc crc on csic.cfg_rule_calc_id = crc.id and crc.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and csic.is_deleted = FALSE
and csic.cfg_rule_calc_id = #{params.cfgRuleCalcId}

select crc.id as cfgRuleCalcId, crc.name, crc.code, crc.start_calc_date startCalcDate, crc.end_calc_date endCalcDate, crc.sale_type saleType, crc.file_url, crc.create_user_name, crc.create_time createTime, csic.id, csic.sku_id skuId, csic.sku_no skuNo, csic.country, csic.shop_id, csic.platform, csic.sales_qty_json, csic.avg_sales_qty_json, csic.month_real_sales_qty_json, csic.month_sales_estimate_qty_json, csic.cfg_rule_calc_id, csic.update_time updateTime, csic.update_user_name, csic.remark, csic.r2_score as r2Score, csic.mape_score as mapeScore, csic.mae_score as maeScore, csic.mse_score as mseScore, csic.rmse_score as rmseScore from calc_sales_info_dim csic inner join cfg_rule_calc crc on csic.cfg_rule_calc_id = crc.id and crc.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and csic.is_deleted = FALSE
and exists (select id from calc_sales_info_favorite where is_deleted = false and cfg_rule_calc_id = crc.id and user_id = #{uid})
order by
${item.field} ${item.sort}
csic.update_time desc

select crc.id as cfgRuleCalcId, crc.create_user_name, crc.create_time createTime, crc.sale_type saleType, crc.file_url, crc.name, crc.code, crc.start_calc_date startCalcDate, crc.end_calc_date endCalcDate from cfg_rule_calc as crc where ${params.sqlMap.default} and crc.is_deleted = FALSE

${item.field} ${item.sort}
crc.update_time desc

select csid.id, csid.sku_id, csid.sku_no, csid.shop_id, csid.platform, csid.country, csid.cfg_rule_calc_id, csid.his_data_md5, crc.start_calc_date, crc.end_calc_date, crc.name from calc_sales_info_dim csid inner join cfg_rule_calc crc on csid.cfg_rule_calc_id = crc.id and crc.is_deleted = false where csid.is_deleted = false and csid.sku_id = #{dto.skuId} and csid.shop_id = #{dto.shopId} and crc.start_calc_date = #{dto.startCalcDate}

select csid.id, csid.sku_id, csid.sku_no, csid.shop_id, csid.platform, csid.country, csid.cfg_rule_calc_id, csid.his_data_md5, crc.start_calc_date, crc.end_calc_date, crc.name from calc_sales_info_dim csid inner join cfg_rule_calc crc on csid.cfg_rule_calc_id = crc.id and crc.is_deleted = false where csid.is_deleted = false and csid.id in
#{id}
